titulo: Culture and art: talking about books, films and music: The passé simple in reading

aula.titulo: Culture and art: talking about books, films and music
aula.objetivo: Present and review a work (book, film, exhibition, music) and recognize the passé simple, the tense of literary narrative.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: the passé simple is a tense of books, historical newspapers and biographies. In speech, the passé composé is used. You only need to recognize it. STEP 2: -er verbs: endings -a (he/she) and -èrent (they): «il parla, ils parlèrent». STEP 3: -ir and -re verbs: -it and -irent: «il finit, ils finirent», «il répondit». STEP 4: common irregulars: «être → il fut», «avoir → il eut», «faire → il fit», «dire → il dit», «venir → il vint», «voir → il vit», «pouvoir → il put», «vouloir → il voulut», «naître → il naquit», «mourir → il mourut». STEP 5: it narrates completed actions in sequence: «Il ouvrit la porte, entra et s'assit.» STEP 6: to read it, mentally swap it for the passé composé: «il fit» = «il a fait».
blocos.comparacao: in English «he did» (the simple past) serves for speech and writing alike. French splits the job: «il a fait» in conversation and «il fit» in books and biographies. So when reading a novel, «il fut» is just «he was».

erros.certo: Hier, il a fait un gâteau.

blocos.enunciado: Read aloud: «Il naquit à Lyon, fit des études de droit, puis vint à Paris.» Then rewrite it in the passé composé and say it again.
Say three sentences about a work with «il s'agit de», «raconter» and «se dérouler».
